svg.title: PED categories for vessels with group 2 gases
svg.text: PED 2014/68/EU – categories of vessels for group 2 gases (compressed air), Annex II Table 2 – with the VC receivers
Log–log chart: PS = maximum allowable pressure [bar], V = volume [L]. Boundaries are lines PS·V = constant. Check the original table (special lines for V ≤ 1 L).
VC20 → SPVD A1 (PED would be IV)
tank maker does CE + notified body
you keep DoC + certificate in file
